cargo-audit-version.description: Exact version of cargo-audit to install; bumped via .github releases

cargo-deny-version.description: Exact version of cargo-deny to install; bumped via .github releases

extra-lockfiles.description: Newline-separated lockfiles to audit in addition to the one in working-directory, given relative to it. A second workspace has its own Cargo.lock and its own dependency graph, and auditing only the root leaves it unexamined.

ref.description: Branch to audit, one of develop or main, or empty for the ref that triggered the run

toolchain.description: Rust toolchain to pin the audit and deny jobs to

steps.name: Reject an unknown ref
steps.run:
echo "::error::ref must be empty, develop or main."
exit 1

steps.name: Take the lockfiles of the audited branch
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
prefix=""
[ "$WORKDIR" = . ] || prefix="${WORKDIR%/}/"
dir="$(mktemp -d "$RUNNER_TEMP/audited.XXXXXX")"
take() {
  mkdir -p "$dir/$(dirname "$1")"
  git show "origin/${REF}:${prefix}$1" > "$dir/$1"
}
take Cargo.lock
while read -r lockfile; do
  [ -n "$lockfile" ] && take "$lockfile"
done <<< "$EXTRA_LOCKFILES"
# The audit runs with this directory as its working directory, and
# cargo-audit reads `.cargo/audit.toml` from there. A branch without the
# file gets an empty list, so no list of another branch or of the runner
# can apply to it.
if git cat-file -e "origin/${REF}:${prefix}.cargo/audit.toml" 2> /dev/null; then
  take .cargo/audit.toml
else
  mkdir -p "$dir/.cargo"
  printf '[advisories]\nignore = []\n' > "$dir/.cargo/audit.toml"
fi
echo "dir=$dir" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

steps.name: Install toolchain
steps.run:
rustup toolchain install "$TOOLCHAIN" --profile minimal
rustup default "$TOOLCHAIN"

steps.name: Run cargo audit
steps.run:
out="$PWD"
args=()
if [ -n "$AUDITED_DIR" ]; then
  cd "$AUDITED_DIR"
  args+=(--file "$AUDITED_DIR/Cargo.lock")
fi
if ! cargo audit --json --deny warnings "${args[@]}" > "$out/audit.json" 2> "$out/audit.stderr"; then
  cat "$out/audit.stderr" >&2
  exit 1
fi

steps.name: Run cargo audit on the extra lockfiles
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
out="$PWD"
run_dir="${AUDITED_DIR:-$PWD}"
echo "$EXTRA_LOCKFILES" | while read -r lockfile; do
  [ -n "$lockfile" ] || continue
  source="${AUDITED_DIR:+$AUDITED_DIR/}$lockfile"
  if [ ! -f "$source" ]; then
    echo "::error::$lockfile does not exist; the input is stale."
    exit 1
  fi
  # The name carries the whole path with the separators folded, so
  # two workspaces cannot land on the same report: `fuzz/Cargo.lock`
  # becomes `audit-fuzz-Cargo.json`. Naming it after the file alone
  # gives every workspace the name `audit-Cargo.json`.
  name="$(printf '%s' "${lockfile%.lock}" | tr '/' '-')"
  if ! (cd "$run_dir" && cargo audit --json --deny warnings --file "$source" \
      > "$out/audit-${name}.json" 2> "$out/audit-${name}.stderr"); then
    cat "$out/audit-${name}.stderr" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
done

steps.name: Reject an unknown ref
steps.run:
echo "::error::ref must be empty, develop or main."
exit 1

steps.name: Install toolchain
steps.run:
rustup toolchain install "$TOOLCHAIN" --profile minimal
rustup default "$TOOLCHAIN"
